environment.coverage: One fresh isolated native session with the actual Arrille NPC, HALVETH native windows and actual save/reload. No personal save loaded.

sourceUnitSuite.scope: Local Windows source and temporary fixtures

limits: The test invokes the native Worldlife interface with a real nearby NPC; it does not automate a physical mouse click on every display resolution.
A title-screen launch or isolated test does not prove performance or compatibility with every personal save and mod combination.
Free-form AI responses still use the optional local Ollama service; in-process model inference is not part of 0.8.1.
